=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:11108-11109 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Final CI on head 98a03f2 (run 45845286465) fails test_post_sync_test_repair_keeps_review_autofix_well_under_the_size_guard in tests-system-python (21) and orchestrate-poll (1). The cause is that .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml is 430,902 bytes, over the 430,000-byte limit, and those failures then make the aggregate lint job fail too.
  WHY: The size check fails every time on any tree that contains the grown file, so the merge gate stays red whatever this PR's code does. The growth came from base commits merged from orchestrator/project-9650 (merge base 226a989), and review_autofix.yml is not in pr_changed_files.txt. The fix (moving run bodies into scripts/ on the base branch) is outside the Phase 9 files_touched grant. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5=NIT (mapped to low), z-ai_glm-5_3-flash=MAJOR (mapped to high); the higher one is used.
- tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py:1229 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: test_route_scope_block_step_sits_before_the_handler_with_the_same_if fails in tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and tests-system-python (18) on head 98a03f2. The "Verify nothing-to-implement block" step sits between "Route planning scope block" and "Handle blocked planning output" in .github/workflows/plan.yml.
  WHY: Two base-branch changes conflict on step order in plan.yml in the merged tree. The failure does not reproduce at the review ref, this PR does not touch plan.yml, and no edit inside the PR's grant can fix it. Source severity: NIT.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:690-706, 858-907 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cross-pollination summary repeats a claim from gemini-3_1-flash-lite that `_observe_entry` calls `_observable_condition` without passing `repo`, which would leave the credential-same-repository guard unable to match.
  WHY: The claim is disproved. The call site reads `classified = [_observable_condition(title, lines, repo) for title, lines in blocks]`, and `repo` is filled in from `tick()`, so the call never fails at runtime. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected the same claim in their notes (citing line 939), without listing it as a finding. Source severity: NIT.
- scripts/operator_step_daily_tick.sh:35-46 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `git fetch` fails, the script only logs a warning and keeps going. A stale local `refs/tags/stable` from an earlier run would then pass `git rev-parse --verify` and the 40-hex check, so the tick would run against a stable tag that is not current.
  WHY: GitHub-hosted runners do not normally keep tags between jobs, so the stale-tag window is close to zero. The reviewer calls this a fail-open design choice rather than a bug. Source severity: NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR modifies scripts/stage_switches.json, which neither the Phase 9 file list nor the files_touched grant in issue #10118 includes. It adds the OPERATOR_STEP_DAILY_TICK_ENABLED entry, and the last run deleted the GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED entry. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes that both edits are needed for tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py (line 108, lines 131-146) and that judges entry[15]-[17] instructed them, so the PR body should document the scope widening rather than revert it. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5=NIT, openai_gpt-6-luna=MAJOR.
- requirement: Phase 9 deliverables per `docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md` (R6).
  expected_change_site: scripts/operator_step_issue.py, scripts/operator_step_daily_tick.sh, .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml, tests/test_operator_step_issue.py, README.md, docs/INVENTORY.md, changelog.d/10118-operator-step-daily-tick.md, agents.d/10118-operator-step-daily-tick.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer reports that all nine files are present in PR_CHANGED_FILES. The tick is wired into the `collect-logs` job at `0 6 * * *`, the defaults live inside the script, and every check fails closed. The stage_switches.json touch is justified by the contract in tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py. Source severity: NIT.
- requirement: Final CI must be green on head 98a03f2fcfc6 for merge.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (430,902 bytes vs 430,000 limit) and .github/workflows/plan.yml (step ordering between "Route planning scope block" and "Handle blocked planning output")
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither file appears in PR_CHANGED_FILES. Both failures reproduce on the merge base (CI_FINAL_PR_BASE_SHA 226a989), so they come from orchestrator/project-9650 and the fix belongs outside this PR's grant. Source severity: BLOCKER.
